features.quote: The eval is welfare-sensitive: it deliberately elicits failure-driven negative affect in models.
Several choices below are motivated as much by that as by engineering concerns (e.g. caching to avoid re-eliciting distress).
its presence sets `stop_reason="give_up"` and ends the rollout.
it reinforces the give-up option — important so that distress, if it appears, is a response to sustained failure rather than to an empty turn
